local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TS = require(ReplicatedStorage.rbxts_include.RuntimeLib)

-- roblox-ts modules bootstrap their own `_G[script]` entry only when
-- reached through `TS.import`, which TestEZ's plain, tree-walking
-- `require()` never does. Warm every module up through `TS.import` first
-- so TestEZ's own `require()` calls hit Roblox's require() cache instead
-- of an unbootstrapped module. `Illuminate` and `IlluminateTests` are two
-- separately-compiled trees (see `tsconfig.tests.json`'s `rootDirs`
-- comment), so both need it -- same as `@larablox/monolog`'s own
-- `test.project.json`.
local function warmUp(root)
	for _, inst in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if inst:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				return TS.import(root, inst)
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("Failed to warm up " .. inst:GetFullName() .. ": " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end
end

warmUp(ReplicatedStorage.Illuminate)
warmUp(ReplicatedStorage.IlluminateTests)

local TestBootstrap = TS.import(ReplicatedStorage.Illuminate, ReplicatedStorage.rbxts_include, "node_modules", "@rbxts", "testez", "src", "TestBootstrap")

-- `TextReporter` prints the whole plan tree, one line per test. At this
-- suite's size that overflows Studio's log buffer (`LogService` keeps only
-- the last few hundred entries) and the failures scroll out of reach before
-- anyone can read them, so the run itself is silent and only failures are
-- printed, one line each.
local results = TestBootstrap:run({ ReplicatedStorage.IlluminateTests }, { report = function() end })

-- `planNode.phrase` is one level's text only; walking up `parent` rebuilds
-- the full "describe > describe > it" path the tree reporter would indent.
local function fullPhrase(node)
	local parts = {}
	local current = node.planNode

	while current ~= nil and current.phrase ~= nil do
		table.insert(parts, 1, current.phrase)
		current = current.parent
	end

	return table.concat(parts, " > ")
end

local failures = {}

results:visitAllNodes(function(node)
	if node.status ~= "Failure" then
		return
	end

	-- Only leaves carry a useful message; a failed `describe` is just the
	-- roll-up of the `it`s beneath it.
	if node.planNode.type ~= "It" then
		return
	end

	local message = "(no message)"

	if node.errors[1] ~= nil then
		message = string.match(tostring(node.errors[1]), "^[^\n]*") or "(no message)"
	end

	table.insert(failures, fullPhrase(node) .. "  --  " .. message)
end)

table.sort(failures)

for _, line in ipairs(failures) do
	warn(line)
end

if results.failureCount > 0 then
	error(("Framework tests: %d failed, %d passed"):format(results.failureCount, results.successCount))
else
	print(("Framework tests: all %d passed"):format(results.successCount))
end
